description: This line plot illustrates the training loss evolution over iterations for six different model configurations, comparing their convergence behavior. The x-axis represents the number of iterations, labeled "#Iteration", and spans from 0 to 140,000 on a linear scale, with tick marks appearing at intervals of 20,000. The y-axis represents the loss value, labeled "Loss", and ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The plot contains six distinct lines: a purple line for "Vanilla"; a blue line for "StrmLLM (n=64)"; an orange line for "SepLLM (n=64, H)"; a green line for "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)"; a red line for "SepLLM (n=128)"; and a dark blue line for "SepLLM (n=64)". All lines begin at a high loss value near 3.4 at iteration 0, then rapidly decrease, stabilizing at a low loss value near 2.7-2.8 after approximately 40,000 iterations. The "Vanilla" model starts at a loss of approximately 3.4 and ends at approximately 2.7. The "StrmLLM (n=64)" model starts at approximately 3.4 and ends at approximately 2.9. The "SepLLM (n=64, H)" model starts at approximately 3.4 and ends at approximately 2.8. The "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" model starts at approximately 3.4 and ends at approximately 2.8. The "SepLLM (n=128)" model starts at approximately 3.4 and ends at approximately 2.7. The "SepLLM (n=64)" model starts at approximately 3.4 and ends at approximately 2.8.
